mapper.sql: id, command_id, task_id, task_code, vehicle_id, command_type, stage, status, payload, failure_reason, published_at, acknowledged_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transport_command (command_id, task_id, task_code, vehicle_id, command_type, stage, status, payload, failure_reason, published_at, acknowledged_at, completed_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{commandId}, #{taskId}, #{taskCode}, #{vehicleId}, #{commandType}, #{stage}, #{status}, #{payload}, #{failureReason}, #{publishedAt}, #{acknowledgedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM transport_command WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM transport_command WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status IN ('CREATED', 'PUBLISHED', 'ACKNOWLEDGED')
mapper.update: UPDATE transport_command SET status = 'FAILED', failure_reason = #{failureReason}, completed_at = #{completedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE command_id = #{commandId} AND status IN ('PUBLISHED', 'ACKNOWLEDGED')
